## Change

Describe the reusable skill behavior or documentation changed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Synthetic known-good and known-fail case added or updated when behavior changed
- [ ] `python scripts/verify.py` passes
- [ ] Current Codex skill validator passes for changed skills
- [ ] Attribution and project-origin boundaries remain accurate
- [ ] No private chat, path, customer data, credential, raw incident log, or production detail added
- [ ] Commits include DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`)
